sections.Overview:
Join the Final Resistance on your P 3 Pinball Platform !
This listing is for a Final Resistance game kit for a P 3 you already own. . To order a new P 3 with this and/or other game kits: click here
Playfield Module The imposing alien spaceship has a 3-ball rapid-fire cannon and active defenses! The left side of the playfield with 3 multi-function orbits, 1 of the 2 main ramps, and a bi-directional scoop The lower playfield with persistent playfield artwork and virtual light inserts To purchase this game kit for an existing P 3 , add this product to your cart. To purchase a new P 3 with this and/or other game kits, Click here. A Final Resistance artwork package (or a different artwork package, at the buyer’s request) is included with the purchase of a new P 3 . Existing P 3 owners can choose to purchase some or all of the Final Resistance artwork package separately.
